headline: Türkiye September trade deficit narrows 25.8% to $5.16 billion on export growth
summary: Official statistics revealed Türkiye's trade deficit contracted 25.8% year-on-year in September to $5.16 billion as export expansion outpaced imports.
why: Managing the trade deficit is central to stabilizing the Turkish lira and replenishing foreign exchange reserves under current macroeconomic stabilization programs.

impacts.name: Türkiye
impacts.why: Narrowing trade deficits reduce external financing pressures and support current account normalization.
